title: Impartible
summary: IMP'ARTIBLE, adjective 1. Not partible or subject to partition; as an impartible estate. 2. [from impart.] That may be imparted, conferred, bestowed or communicated.

inlines.v: IMP'ARTIBLE, adjective 1. Not partible or subject to partition; as an impartible estate. 2. [from impart.] That may be imparted, conferred, bestowed or communicated.
